verses.text: A Song; a Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, In the city of our God, His holy mountain.
verses.textZh: （可拉後裔的詩歌。）耶和華本為大！在我們神的城中，在他的聖山上，該受大讚美。

verses.text: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, Is Mount Zion [in] the far north, The city of the great King.
verses.textZh: 錫安山─大君王的城，在北面居高華美，為全地所喜悅。

verses.text: God, in her palaces, Has made Himself known as a stronghold.
verses.textZh: 神在其宮中，自顯為避難所。

verses.text: For, lo, the kings assembled themselves, They passed by together.
verses.textZh: 看哪，眾王會合，一同經過。

verses.text: They saw [it], then they were amazed; They were terrified, they fled in alarm.
verses.textZh: 他們見了這城就驚奇喪膽，急忙逃跑。

verses.text: Panic seized them there, Anguish, as of a woman in childbirth.
verses.textZh: 他們在那裡被戰兢疼痛抓住，好像產難的婦人一樣。

verses.text: With the east wind You break the ships of Tarshish.
verses.textZh: 神啊，你用東風打破他施的船隻。

verses.text: As we have heard, so have we seen In the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God; God will establish her forever. Selah.
verses.textZh: 我們在萬軍之耶和華的城中─就是我們神的城中─所看見的，正如我們所聽見的。　神必堅立這城，直到永遠。（細拉）

verses.text: We have thought on Your lovingkindness, O God, In the midst of Your temple.
verses.textZh: 神啊，我們在你的殿中想念你的慈愛。

verses.text: As is Your name, O God, So is Your praise to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
verses.textZh: 神啊，你受的讚美正與你的名相稱，直到地極！你的右手滿了公義。

verses.text: Let Mount Zion be glad, Let the daughters of Judah rejoice Because of Your judgments.
verses.textZh: 因你的判斷，錫安山應當歡喜，猶大的城邑（原文是女子）應當快樂。

verses.text: Walk about Zion and go around her; Count her towers;
verses.textZh: 你們當周遊錫安，四圍旋繞，數點城樓，

verses.text: Consider her ramparts; Go through her palaces, That you may tell [it] to the next generation.
verses.textZh: 細看他的外郭，察看他的宮殿，為要傳說到後代。

verses.text: For such is God, Our God forever and ever; He will guide us until death.
verses.textZh: 因為這神永永遠遠為我們的　神；他必作我們引路的，直到死時。
